exposure: Mothers' knowledge of breastfeeding (timing, benefits, colostrum)
Mothers' breastfeeding practices (early initiation, planned duration)
cohort: 100 mothers of children under one year of age, visiting a service hospital in Jammu & Kashmir, India.
finding: The majority of mothers demonstrated good knowledge and practices regarding breastfeeding and complementary feeding.
cross-section timing: Data was collected over a six-month period among mothers of children under one year of age.
